title: 'Muse' womens singing group at re-enactment dinner
description: The ladies' singing group Muse performed at both the ribbon-cutting ceremony and the dinner on July 4, 2001. From left to right: Beth McMillan, Carolyn Everett, Jeanne Shaw, Judy Bouma, Sandy Langdon, Joanne Barrett, Rachel MacDonald, and Karen Arnold.
